name: DBGate
description: Web based UI for managing and exploring SQL database data

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-dbgate application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-dbgate
  # The `big-bear-dbgate` service definition
  big-bear-dbgate:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-dbgate
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: dbgate/dbgate:7.3.2-alpine@sha256:16adb42330dd7043d4418887b948ca066f9567e252ca6368e62388a5df9d074e
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Mounting the local homarr/configs directory to /app/data/configs inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config:/root/.dbgate
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 3000 of the host to port 3000 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
